author: RetPlanology
text: Growth doesn't bring complexity. Ignoring growth does. You hit 50 employees, you call an advisor. You hit 100, you automate the audit prep. The problem isn't the milestone. It's the people still doing it manually at scale.

You don't scale without headcount. You optimize before you scale. Most people skip that step and wonder why hiring ten people solves nothing. Fix the process first. Then one person handles what three used to handle.

draft: The profitable move and the right move aren't opposites. They're sequential. Cut the waste first. Then cut the people. Le Marquier did it backwards — hired, then optimized. Cost them six months and $400k. Order matters.

topic: DTC customer experience after the sale
text: Most DTC brands obsess over the checkout experience and ignore the 90 days after. That's where you lose them. The post-purchase silence is the killer. Build the onboarding call, not another email. One human voice. Le Marquier did it. Retention went up 34%.

Being first doesn't matter. Being right matters. Slack wasn't first. Figma wasn't first. Le Marquier wasn't first in voice AI. They were first to solve the actual problem everyone else was ignoring. Speed to market loses to speed to insight.

draft: Your specialty brand doesn't have a customer service problem. It has a customer education problem. People call because they don't know how to use it. Automate the manual, keep humans for the rest. The margin you save goes back into the product that shouldn't need explaining in the first place.
